subject: Lighthouse pilot — model-fit priorities & token sizing
body:
From: Kevin Zhao <kevin@lighthouse.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Lighthouse pilot kickoff — context and throughput

Marcus —

Thanks again for the demo last week. The product team reviewed and we want to run a month-long pilot against two core flows: (1) conversational summarization for customer support threads (avg. 1.5kb text input, multi-turn histories up to ~6 turns) and (2) a document Q&A flow over monthly reports (single large doc + question).

Quick facts from our end:
- Expected monthly active users for pilot: ~1,200
- Avg queries per user/day (projected): 3.2
- Support thread average tokens per request (after trimming): ~450 input tokens, expected 220 tokens generated
- Doc Q&A average: 1,500 input tokens, 120 tokens generated

We want Redwood to recommend a model shortlist, context-length configuration, and a rough token-volume estimate + recommended runtime footprint (hosted vs. dedicated) for the pilot. Can you also surface any risk areas if we try a larger context window for the Q&A flow?

Attachments: lighthouse_model_matrix.xlsx (we've prefilled some expected traffic rows)

-Kevin

---

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Kevin Zhao <kevin@lighthouse.ai>, Lighthouse Onboarding <onboarding@lighthouse.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 11:40:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Lighthouse pilot kickoff — model-fit priorities & token sizing

Thanks Kevin — this is helpful. We're assembling a short model-fit proposal and sizing runbook. High-level notes below; full doc attached.

Summary recommendation (pilot scope):
- Shortlist: 1) Mistral-Chat-16k (quantized) for conversational summarization (good latency/quality balance), 2) LlamaX-70B-32k for doc Q&A (higher context, higher cost), 3) Falcon-40B-8k as fallback for low-cost/fast replies.
- Context lengths: convo: 8k window should be more than enough for 6 turns at ~1.5k raw text (after trimming we expect under 4k). Doc Q&A: target 32k but evaluate whether 16k with chunked retrieval + RAG works (tradeoff: latency vs. cost).
- Pilot token estimate (monthly): approx 1,200 users * 3.2 q/u/day * 30 days = 115,200 sessions. Token mix estimate: 65% convo, 35% doc Q&A => ~75M input tokens + 15M generated tokens => ~90M tokens total/month. (See token_projection_q3.csv)
- Runtime suggestion: start hosted with dedicated burst lanes. If p95 latency or peak concurrency requires it, convert to a small Dedicated pool (2-4 A100-equivalent GPUs) after week 2.

Open risks we flagged:
- 32k context on LlamaX-70B can multiply memory use and lead to both higher tail latency and reduced concurrent throughput. Prefetching + prefix caching will help but expect >2x cost if we run many parallel long-context requests.
- Document chunking strategy: if RAG implemented at the retrieval layer, we can frequently avoid full 32k windows. Need to define chunk size and overlap.

Action items for next week:
1) Redwood to deliver concrete model shortlist + per-model cost per 1000 tokens and p95 latency under pilot traffic (ETA: 2026-10-04).
2) Lighthouse to confirm retention policy and whether any content is considered regulated PII (affects private vs hosted decision).
3) Align on SOW items in attached draft.

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Sr. Customer Solutions, Redwood Inference

[Attachment: model_fit_proposal.pdf (PDF)]

---

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: compute sizing thoughts for Lighthouse pilot

Folks —

I ran a quick back-of-envelope based on Marcus's estimates and Kevin's usage numbers. Key numbers:
- Sessions/month: 115,200 (matches Marcus)
- Avg token/session: convo ~670 tokens (input+output), doc Q&A ~1620 tokens -> weighted average ~940 tokens/session
- Monthly token estimate ~108M (small discrepancy vs Marcus's 90M due to conservative gen estimate)

Compute sizing (pilot):
- If we use Mistral-Chat-16k for 65% of traffic and LlamaX-70B-32k for 35% with 70% peak concurrency factor, we should provision:
  - Hosted baseline: 6 concurrent Mistral streams + 2 concurrent LlamaX long-context concurrent slots. That maps to roughly 3x standard small-hosted instances; anticipate p95 latencies in 350-700ms for Mistral and 1.8-2.4s for LlamaX under pilot traffic.
  - Dedicated standby: 2x H100-equivalent for week-to-week scaling if we see sustained >10k QPS per minute.

Notes: quantization (8-bit/4-bit) on LlamaX is an option but will need model validation for hallucination risk on Q&A tasks. Also recommend a small eval set (20 representative queries per flow) for the first 48 hours post-launch to monitor quality drift.

-S

From: Priya Sharma <priya@lighthouse.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 10:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Lighthouse pilot — updated token breakdown and regulatory note

Marcus/Team —

Thanks for the breakdown. A few clarifications from the product and security teams:
- We confirmed only emails need moderate redaction; no regulated PHI expected. We can provide a sample redaction script.
- Updated traffic: we expect a higher doc Q&A share after promotional emails; new split 55% convo / 45% doc Q&A. Revised monthly token estimate attached.
- Request: please include a model fallback policy in the SOW (e.g., if LlamaX latency spikes >2.5s, fallback to Falcon-40B-8k with a short context and retrieval augmentation).

Attachments: token_projection_q3.csv (updated)

Best,
Priya
Product Ops, Lighthouse Analytics

---

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Kevin Zhao <kevin@lighthouse.ai>, Priya Sharma <priya@lighthouse.ai>, Lighthouse Onboarding <onboarding@lighthouse.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 04 Oct 2026 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Lighthouse pilot — model-fit priorities & token sizing (final prep)

Thanks all — quick summary and next steps before kickoff: 

1) Model shortlist (final):
   - Primary convo: Mistral-Chat-16k (quantized) — good balance of latency/cost.
   - Primary doc Q&A: LlamaX-70B-32k (evaluate 16k+RAG in week 1).
   - Fallback: Falcon-40B-8k with retrieval augmentation and reduced context.

2) Token/compute baseline: updated monthly total ~125M tokens (Priya's updated split). Redwood to publish per-model cost estimates and p95 latency numbers in the shared Drive link by EOD tomorrow.

3) Operational guardrails:
   - Canary week: enable traffic shadowing for 48 hours, run eval set (20 queries/flow) every 6 hours.
   - Fallback policy: automatic route to Falcon if LlamaX p95 >2.5s for more than 5min window.
   - Data handling: Lighthouse to provide redaction script; Redwood will not persist raw payloads beyond pilot retention policy in SOW unless requested.

4) SOW: Marissa, can you update the SOW to include fallback clause and compute ramp language? I attached a draft SOW (sow_draft_v2.pdf) — please push updates to the Drive folder and ping Kevin/ Priya.

5) Calendar: proposed kickoff + tech sync — Tue 2026-10-12 10:00 PT. Kevin, Priya, confirm availability and whether you want a separate security walk-through with our compliance lead.

I'll follow up with the cost per-1k-token spreadsheet and the latency table.

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
Sr. Customer Solutions, Redwood Inference

[Attachments referenced above]
